item.title: How Apollo’s SoftBank ties unlocked an unprecedented OpenAI bet
item.description: Since 2021, Apollo has provided and arranged more than $15 billion of debt for SoftBank across multiple deals.

item.title: Five arrested in crackdown on rip-offs targeting foreign visitors in Tokyo
item.description: The crackdown came in response to a surge in cases of foreign visitors being overcharged at Kabukicho establishments.

item.title: In the competition for cultural influence, AI has a default country
item.description: One version supplied a tidy answer: Japan is the safe choice, a culture no filter objects to.

item.title: LDP, JIP and DPP submit Lower House seat-cut bill, driving contentious reform
item.description: Opposition parties have said that the move will give greater weight to single-member districts and make it harder for smaller parties to win seats.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
